ABOUT EA MASSAGE THERAPY

Your body. Your goals. Our focus.

Professional, personalised massage therapy designed to support relaxation, movement, recovery and overall wellbeing.

Benefits of Massage

  • Support for faster recovery after exercise

  • A stronger sense of wellbeing and recovery confidence

THE TREATMENT PROCESS

Every Session Starts With You

Your treatment includes the full process from assessment through to aftercare.

01

Assessment & Consultation

We discuss your needs, goals, concerns and any relevant training or lifestyle factors before treatment begins.

02

Treatment

Your massage treatment is tailored to you and the areas we have identified during the consultation.

03

Post-Treatment Advice

After your session, you receive practical advice to support recovery and help you get the most from your treatment.
